scope: safety-local contact sheet; technical baseline only

identity_consistency.reason: Each language keeps one visibly consistent owned character across all five fixtures.

mouth_artifacts.reason: The safety baseline is a still image and has no mouth animation.

motion_naturalness.reason: The safety baseline contains no character motion.

temporal_stability.reason: The frozen still does not visibly drift or change identity.

captions.reason: English captions are readable, but Japanese lines extend beyond the safe horizontal frame and are clipped.

audio_visual_sync.reason: Audio exists, but a still-image baseline provides no mouth movement to judge sync.

character_product_fit.reason: The English monk maps only to ebook-en and the watercolor monk maps only to ebook-ja.

decision: Keep as a deterministic emergency benchmark only. Do not publish or promote. A motion/avatar challenger must preserve identity, keep all captions inside safe margins, and provide judgeable audio-visual sync.
